milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The smooth sandstone slabs are placed at spawn-relative coordinates x=5-8, y=-1, z=-1 to 3. The center of the slab area is approximately (7, -1, 1). The player must navigate near this area and face toward it to demonstrate they have found it. max_distance=5 ensures the player must actually walk to the slab area (spawn is at origin, slabs start at x=5, so distance from spawn to target center is ~7.1 blocks which exceeds 5). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the slabs, confirming visual identification.

Uses inventory_has because mining glowstone drops glowstone_dust into the player's inventory (2-4 dust per block without Silk Touch). The player starts with 0 glowstone_dust, so having at least 1 confirms successful mining. This is the preferred rule type for mine tasks where the mined drop ends up in inventory. Wooden pickaxe can break glowstone (no tool tier requirement). The glowstone cluster is at spawn-relative (7-8, 3, 1-2) on the ceiling, within player reach from ground level.

Uses inventory_has because crafting orange_dye (shapeless recipe: 1 red_dye + 1 yellow_dye) places the result in the player's inventory. The player starts with 0 orange_dye and has 4 red_dye + 4 yellow_dye in inventory. Having at least 1 orange_dye confirms successful crafting at the crafting table located at spawn-relative (11, 0, 1). This is the preferred rule type for craft tasks.
